description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa trigger
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
